title: Record the completed compression error sum
body:
## Summary
- The completed compression error is `sqrt(2) 2^{-p}` plus four smaller terms, and the claim is that this stays below `2·2^{-p}` for every precision `p ≥ 101`.
- `99² > 2·70²`, so `sqrt(2) < 99/70` and the remaining room is `41/70` of a `p`-grid unit. The other four terms fit in that room for every such precision.
- The same comparison was evaluated directly for precisions 101 through 200. The selected κ is unchanged.
